observations.subject: TASK-022 Supplier lifecycle command matrix, idempotency, guarded delete and browser-discovered command fix
observations.source_ref: Authenticated HTTP matrix on 2026-09-15 exercised activate/replay/suspend/reactivate/block/unblock/archive/restore and controlled Draft delete. Initial browser evidence exposed that target-only validation could misclassify Restore as Suspend; implementation was tightened to command-specific allowed source states plus latest-action replay proof. Recheck returned STATUS_TRANSITION_INVALID for wrong Suspend, Unblock and Restore, preserved true Restore replay at version 13, and left Supplier 11 Suspended at version 15. Synthetic Draft 62 was device-password deleted and then returned SUPPLIER_NOT_FOUND. Focused tests passed 13/13, real MySQL lifecycle/create/update integration passed 3/3, root lint passed; all browser 409s were deliberately exercised negative cases.
